titles.title: Inside Red Canna

description: A huge, geometric red canna flower blooms at the center of the composition. Its layered red, pink, and purple petals expand from its dark center. The petals contrast with a geometric, abstract green background.
imageCaption: Image courtesy of a scanned transparency made for Georgia O'Keeffe: Catalogue Raisonné. This image has not been color proofed and may differ from the original. It will be replaced when newer photography becomes available.
